body.name: Trimmed inverse-probability radius
body.construction: \(\rho_\alpha(w,q)=\inf_{J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,L\}}[\sum_{l\notin J}w_l+\sqrt{\log(2/\alpha)\sum_{l\in J}w_l^2/q_l}+\{\log(2/\alpha)/6\}\max_{l\in J}w_l/q_l]\), with the maximum over \(J=\varnothing\) equal to zero, and \(\rho_0(w,q)=\inf_J[\sum_{l\notin J}w_l+(\sum_{l\in J}w_l^2/q_l)^{1/2}]\).
